name: css-token-guard
description: Flags hard-coded hex colors and pixel values where your design tokens should be used.

allow.title: Allowed literal colors
allow.description: Comma-separated colors that may stay hard-coded (any notation).

checkSpacing.title: Check pixel values
checkSpacing.description: Also flag px values in spacing, size and radius properties when a size token has exactly that value.

tokenFiles.title: Extra token files
tokenFiles.description: Comma-separated paths (relative to the project root) of token files that are not found automatically.
